title: Skube
tagline: Skube is building a place for anyone to create an on-chain professional profile.
description: The vision of Skube is to be web3 professional profile protocol. With this profile other people (and yourself) will be able to verify the skills you have and can issue badges for numerous skills, achievements gained, experiences participated in, courses completed, and more. With the Skube Profile and dapps build on-top of it, users will gain control over there data, will not have to make multiple profiles for different apps, and employers will not need to spend time verifying resume items when hiring.
how_its_made: Skube is built using next.js on the front-end which makes calls to the blockchain using both Tatum's API and Thirdweb's SDK. Tatum's api really benefited our project because it made blockchain related get requests simple to code. We used Rainbow-kit to allow all types of wallets such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, etc. We deployed our contracts using thirdweb which made us move faster since we had more experience with javascript. The SBTs are stored on IFPS using NFT.Storage. Our profiles are also ENS compatible, so if you mint it using that you will get a profile page at skube.xyz/ENS. Contracts are deployed on Polygon.
